_meta.purpose: Digitization of Schmitt 2016 (dissertation, references/Schmitt_2016_dissertation.pdf) Section 2.2.2 Tetragonal groups, IT(75)-IT(142): every printed per-group table (f-vector | b-ratio | generating grid point) plus block header facts.
_meta.source_pages: printed pp. 27-81 = PDF pages 32-86 (PDF page = printed + 5); Sec. 2.2.3 Trigonal begins on printed p. 81 / PDF 86 after the IT(142) table
_meta.method: SINGLE-PASS VISUAL transcription (rendered page images, pdftoppm 120 dpi, read page by page by Fable 5.1, 2026-09-04), typed independently of the text layer, then diffed row-for-row against (i) a fresh pdftotext -layout parse and (ii) harness/schmitt_tetragonal_rows_harvested.json (the phase-2 sweep's text-layer harvest). 0 content discrepancies. NOT a second independent human/agent re-key: a second independent re-key remains a G5 duty for any group hosting a finalist.
_meta.conventions: f-vector = (vertices, edges, facets) as printed; b-ratio = ||b3'||/||b1'|| as an exact rational string; generating grid point = exact rational triple in Schmitt's space-group coordinates (his tetragonal conventions confirmed by G2b: points in space-group coordinates, b-ratio = c/a; NOTE origin choice 2 for the 13 two-origin groups and second-enantiomorph z->-z for 95/96, see PHASE2_SCHMITT_ORIGIN_CHECK.md). No frequency column is printed in ANY tetragonal table (unlike the cubic Sec. 2.2.5 tables): 'freq' is null throughout.
_meta.shared_tables: IT(76)/IT(78), IT(91)/IT(95), IT(92)/IT(96) are enantiomorphic pairs printed as ONE table each (65 printed blocks for 68 groups).
_meta.checks: Euler V-E+F=2 asserted for all 1476 rows; G2b rows IT(75)(10,15,7)@1/2, IT(76)(44,66,24)@797/1000, IT(77)(28,42,16)@1/2 present verbatim; per-group max facets vs Sec. 2.3 remarks recorded in SCHMITT_TETRAGONAL_DIGITIZATION_2026-09-04.md

row_format.pdf_page: PDF page the row is printed on
